correctness.rationale: Pencovitch's exact formula reduces the positive simple genus to a ceiling of one half of a maximum of affine Levine--Tristram signatures, with a separately stated genus-zero Arf condition. For \(h=g_4^{\mathrm{top}}(K\#-J)\), additivity of signatures and Powell's topological bound give \(|M(K)-M(J)|\le2h\). The ceiling changes by at most \(h\). If one genus is zero, the same estimate bounds the other by \(h\); when \(h=0\), concordance invariance of signatures and Arf preserves the genus-zero branch. The bundled checker exhausts the resulting arithmetic lemma over finite ranges.

value.rationale: The simple relative genus carries a nontrivial cyclic-complement constraint, so its behavior under changing the boundary knot is not supplied by ordinary surface gluing. The theorem gives a clean stability principle with the natural constant one: perturbing a knot by topological concordance genus \(h\) changes the exact simple genus by at most \(h\). The crossing-change corollary makes the recent formula robust under diagrammatic modifications and gives a practical way to compare values without recomputing the full signature maximum each time.
